title: Eric's launch-week TikTok — Novo Nordisk, GLP-1s, and the non-profit board that made them possible
summary: Eric posts a launch-week TikTok pulling the Novo Nordisk story from Incorruptible — the 100-year-old pharma company that invented insulin and GLP-1 drugs, protected by a non-profit board structure that traces back to one of Denmark's first female doctors and her Nobel Laureate husband.
blockquote:
This story will bend your mind about the invention of GLP-1 drugs and insulin by a 100 year old pharma company and protected by their non-profit board. Founded by one of Denmark's first female doctors and her Nobel Laureate husband.
The full story is in my new book Incorruptible. On sale now.
